patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Stops the full-screen subscription takeover and the promo banner at the top.
Experimental. Stops the app and NYT from recording which articles you read. Includes Block analytics & tracking.
Removes the Continue with Google and Continue with Facebook sign-in options.
Removes the ads from the app's sections, feeds, and slideshows.
